title: 接続表現の分布分析：租税法学論文の集計スクリプトと判断の記録 (Distribution Analysis of Connectives in Japanese Tax Law Papers: Scripts and Decision Records)
description:
Scripts and decision records for the distribution analysis of sentence-initial connectives in Japanese tax law papers (Zeihogaku, Zeidai Ronso, Zeidai Journal, 2015-2023).

Scripts are under the MIT License. Data in data/ (decision records, target list, dictionary) are under CC BY 4.0. The texts and PDFs of the analyzed articles are not included.
